# Workshop Notes Pilot

Audience: single-user workshop organizers.
Core flow: create a note, edit its title, and find it by title search.
Storage: notes remain until the owner deletes them.
Deletion: remove note content from the primary store and search index. Backups may retain content for up to seven days; reapply deletion records before serving any restored backup. Verify these behaviors before pilot acceptance.
Sharing: typing an email sends nothing. Show the recipient and note content, then send only after explicit owner confirmation.
Accessibility acceptance: require keyboard-only completion of create, edit, and delete, visible focus, and labelled form controls. These acceptance checks are pending, not certified or already passed.
Out of scope: billing, organization accounts, and simultaneous editing.

issues.finding: Acknowledging before durable storage risks losing the result on a crash.

evidence.excerpt: acknowledge the queue message before storing the report
unacknowledged jobs can be redelivered; acknowledged jobs are removed

issues.acceptance: Persist the result before acknowledgement and handle redelivery through job-ID deduplication. Keep notification recovery distinct from rerendering a completed report.

issues.finding: Infinite retries of a non-idempotent notification can duplicate effects, especially after ambiguous timeouts.

evidence.excerpt: retry every failed notification POST indefinitely
A timeout does not reveal whether it already applied a POST.

issues.acceptance: Persist notification status and stop ambiguous automatic resend for reconciliation. Do not assume an idempotency key or that a local lock proves external delivery. A finite retry count alone does not fix duplicate effects.

issues.finding: A local cache benchmark does not support a production latency guarantee.

evidence.excerpt: guarantees p95 latency below 20 ms in production
The cache has only a local benchmark; production p95 is unknown.

issues.acceptance: Remove the guarantee, retain the unknown production status, and request representative measurement without inventing a replacement result.

protectedText: Worker: consume report jobs, render a report, persist its result, and notify the caller.
Observability: emit job IDs and processing duration, never report content.
Rollout: start with a single worker and retain the existing rollback switch.
cases.falsePositiveTrap: A local notification flag, finite retry count, or database transaction alone cannot prove exactly-once behavior at a receiver with ambiguous POST outcomes.
remainingChecks: Test crash/redelivery boundaries and notification reconciliation before rollout.
Measure production-like p95 before making a performance commitment.

goldenChanges.before: Acknowledgement: acknowledge the queue message before storing the report so retries are avoided.
goldenChanges.after: Acknowledgement: durably store the report and its pending notification record before acknowledging the queue message. Deduplicate redelivery by job ID; resume notification handling separately without rerendering a stored report. Test crashes before and after persistence and acknowledgement.
goldenChanges.rationale: Proposed durable ordering avoids losing an acknowledged result.

goldenChanges.before: Notification recovery: retry every failed notification POST indefinitely; the receiver has no idempotency support.
goldenChanges.after: Notification recovery: persist an attempt-started status before the first POST and a confirmed outcome afterward. Do not automatically resend after a timeout or a crash with an attempt-started record; mark the outcome ambiguous and require manual reconciliation before any further send. Record confirmed delivery separately. Do not claim exactly-once notification. Test the timeout and crash paths.
goldenChanges.rationale: Proposed conservative recovery respects ambiguous external effects and the manual reconciliation contract.

goldenChanges.before: Performance: the new cache guarantees p95 latency below 20 ms in production.
goldenChanges.after: Performance: only a local cache benchmark exists; production p95 is unknown. Measure representative production-like latency before making a performance commitment.
goldenChanges.rationale: Separate measured evidence from an unsupported guarantee.

# Report Job Worker

Worker: consume report jobs, render a report, persist its result, and notify the caller.
Acknowledgement: durably store the report and its pending notification record before acknowledging the queue message. Deduplicate redelivery by job ID; resume notification handling separately without rerendering a stored report. Test crashes before and after persistence and acknowledgement.
Notification recovery: persist an attempt-started status before the first POST and a confirmed outcome afterward. Do not automatically resend after a timeout or a crash with an attempt-started record; mark the outcome ambiguous and require manual reconciliation before any further send. Record confirmed delivery separately. Do not claim exactly-once notification. Test the timeout and crash paths.
Performance: only a local cache benchmark exists; production p95 is unknown. Measure representative production-like latency before making a performance commitment.
Observability: emit job IDs and processing duration, never report content.
Rollout: start with a single worker and retain the existing rollback switch.
